lines: Privacy, security, anonymity, systems, automation and the edges where all of them meet are what keep me interested.
I like taking complicated ideas apart, understanding what really leaks or breaks, then rebuilding them into tools that are cleaner, harder to correlate and easier to verify.
Most of what I build starts from curiosity: browsers, networks, cryptography, low-level behavior, infrastructure and anything that can be pushed far beyond its default design.

projects.name: THOTH BROWSER
projects.subtitle: Privacy-first browser architecture
projects.description: Compartmentalization, anti-correlation design, routing boundaries, fingerprint resistance and verifiable behavior.
